snippet.title: One More Plate Trailer
snippet.description:
One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you’ll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3305190/One_More_Plate/
